_comment: Every declared difference between a table in the manuscript and its source table. build.py applies them in this order: omitted rows (data-omit in the template), dropped columns, cut cells, then the rename. check_manuscript.py enforces them: a cut may only delete text from a cell, never add any. Rows are named by their first cell and columns by their header, both as written in the source.
